The only remaining objective is to remove the final GitHub authentication blocker and complete deployment certification.

2. Read canonical GitHub HEAD.
3. Verify GitHub HEAD equals the deployed Render SHA.
4. Verify GitHub Actions executed on that SHA.
5. Record the final merged GitHub SHA.
6. Record the CI run URL and conclusion.
7. Verify Render deployment ID.
8. Confirm:
   GitHub HEAD SHA =
   GitHub Actions SHA =
   Render deployed SHA =
   Live /version SHA.
9. If any mismatch exists, reconcile safely and redeploy.
10. Return the final production certification report with only the remaining evidence.

Do not rerun completed QA unless it is required to verify the final deployment.
